    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">Linter rules</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Details about the Dart linter and its style rules you can choose.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"Linter rules","sourceUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/blob/main/src/content/tools/linter-rules/index.md","issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules&amp;page-source=https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/blob/main/src/content/tools/linter-rules/index.md"}-->

                </header>
                <section class="content">
                  <p>
                    Use the Dart linter to identify possible problems in your Dart code.
                    You can use the linter through your IDE
                    or with the <a href="/tools/dart-analyze"><code>dart analyze</code></a> command.
                    For information on how to enable and disable individual linter rules, see
                    <a href="/tools/analysis#individual-rules">individual rules sections</a> of the 
                    <a href="/tools/analysis">analyzer documentation</a>.
                  </p>
                  <p>
                    This page lists all the linter rules,
                    with details such as when you might want to use each rule,
                    what code patterns trigger it, and
                    how you might fix your code.
                  </p>
                  <aside class="alert alert-success">
                    <div class="alert-header"><span class="material-symbols" translate="no" aria-hidden="true">lightbulb</span><span>Tip</span></div>
                    <div class="alert-content">
                      <p>
                        Linter rules (sometimes called <em>lints</em>) can have false positives,
                        and they don't all agree with each other.
                        For example, some rules are more appropriate for regular Dart packages,
                        and others are designed for Flutter apps.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </aside>
                  <p><a id="predefined-rule-sets"></a></p>
                  <div class="header-wrapper">
                    <h2 id="sets">Sets</h2>
                    <a class="heading-link" href="#sets" aria-label="Link to 'Sets' section">#</a>
                  </div>
                  <p>
                    To avoid the need to individually select compatible linter rules,
                    consider starting with a linter rule set,
                    which the following packages provide:
                  </p>
                  <p><a id="lints"></a></p>
                  <dl>
                    <dt><a href="https://pub.dev/packages/lints">lints</a></dt>
                    <dd>
                      <p>
                        Contains two rule sets curated by the Dart team.
                        We recommend using at least the <code>core</code> rule set,
                        which is used when <a href="https://pub.dev/help/scoring">scoring</a>
                        packages uploaded to <a href="https://pub.dev">pub.dev</a>.
                        Or, better yet, use the <code>recommended</code> rule set,
                        a superset of <code>core</code> that identifies additional issues
                        and enforces style and format.
                        If you're writing Flutter code,
                        use the rule set in the <a href="#flutter_lints"><code>flutter_lints</code></a>
                         package,
                        which builds on <code>lints</code>.
                      </p>
                    </dd>
                  </dl>
                  <p><a id="flutter_lints"></a></p>
                  <dl>
                    <dt><a href="https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_lints">flutter_lints</a></dt>
                    <dd>
                      <p>
                        Contains the <code>flutter</code> rule set,
                        which the Flutter team encourages you to use
                        in Flutter apps, packages, and plugins.
                        This rule set is a superset of the <a href="#lints"><code>recommended</code></a>
                         set,
                        which is itself a superset of the <a href="#lints"><code>core</code></a> set that
                        partially determines the <a href="https://pub.dev/help/scoring">score</a> of
                        packages uploaded to <a href="https://pub.dev">pub.dev</a>.
                      </p>
                    </dd>
                  </dl>
                  <p>
                    To learn how to use a specific rule set,
                    visit the documentation for <a href="/tools/analysis#enabling-linter-rules">enabling and disabling linter rules</a>.
                  </p>
                  <p>
                    To find more predefined rule sets,
                    check out the <a href="https://pub.dev/packages?q=topic:lints"><code>#lints</code> topic</a>
                     on pub.dev.
                  </p>
                  <p><a id="maturity-levels"></a></p>
                  <div class="header-wrapper">
                    <h2 id="status">Status</h2>
                    <a class="heading-link" href="#status" aria-label="Link to 'Status' section">#</a>
                  </div>
                  <p>Each rule has a status or maturity level:</p>
                  <dl>
                    <dt><strong>Stable</strong></dt>
                    <dd>
                      <p>
                        These rules are safe to use and are verified as functional
                        with the latest versions of the Dart language.
                        All rules are considered stable unless
                        they're marked as experimental, deprecated, or removed.
                      </p>
                    </dd>
                    <dt><strong>Experimental</strong></dt>
                    <dd>
                      <p>
                        These rules are still under evaluation and might never be stabilized.
                        Use these with caution and report any issues you come across.
                      </p>
                    </dd>
                    <dt><strong>Deprecated</strong></dt>
                    <dd>
                      <p>
                        These rules are no longer suggested for use
                        and might be removed in a future Dart release.
                      </p>
                    </dd>
                    <dt><strong>Removed</strong></dt>
                    <dd>
                      <p>
                        These rules have already been removed in the
                        latest stable Dart release.
                      </p>
                    </dd>
                  </dl>
                  <div class="header-wrapper">
                    <h2 id="quick-fixes">Quick fixes</h2>
                    <a class="heading-link" href="#quick-fixes" aria-label="Link to 'Quick fixes' section">#</a>
                  </div>
                  <p>
                    Some rules can be fixed automatically using quick fixes.
                    A quick fix is an automated edit
                    targeted at fixing the issue
                    reported by the linter rule.
                  </p>
                  <p>
                    If the rule has a quick fix,
                    it can be applied using <a href="/tools/dart-fix"><code>dart fix</code></a>
                    or using your <a href="/tools#editors">editor with Dart support</a>.
                    To learn more, see <a href="/blog/quick-fixes-for-analysis-issues">Quick fixes for analysis issues</a>.
                  </p>
                  <div class="header-wrapper">
                    <h2 id="rules">Rules</h2>
                    <a class="heading-link" href="#rules" aria-label="Link to 'Rules' section">#</a>
                  </div>
                  <p>
                    The following is an index of all linter rules and
                    a short description of their functionality.
                    To learn more about a specific rule,
                    click the <strong>Learn more</strong> button on its card.
                  </p>
                  <p>
                    For an auto-generated list containing all linter rules
                    in Dart <code>3.12.2</code>,
                    check out <a href="/tools/linter-rules/all">All linter rules</a>.
                  </p>

                  <h1 id="document-title">always_<wbr/>declare_<wbr/>return_<wbr/>types</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the always_declare_return_types linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"always_declare_return_types","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/always_declare_return_types"}-->

                <p>Declare method return types.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>DO</strong> declare method return types.</p>
                <p>
                  When declaring a method or function <em>always</em> specify a return type.
                  Declaring return types for functions helps improve your codebase by allowing the
                  analyzer to more adequately check your code for errors that could occur during
                  runtime.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>always_declare_return_types</code> rule, add <code>always_declare_return_types</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">always_declare_return_types</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>always_declare_return_types: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">always_<wbr/>put_<wbr/>control_<wbr/>body_<wbr/>on_<wbr/>new_<wbr/>line</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the always_put_control_body_on_new_line linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"always_put_control_body_on_new_line","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/always_put_control_body_on_new_line"}-->

                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint has one or more quick fixes available." aria-label="Lint has one or more quick fixes available.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">build</span>
                    <span>Fix available</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Separate the control structure expression from its statement.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>From the <a href="https://flutter.dev/style-guide/">style guide for the flutter repo</a>:</p>
                <p><strong>DO</strong> separate the control structure expression from its statement.</p>
                <p>
                  Don't put the statement part of an <code>if</code>, <code>for</code>, <code>while</code>, <code>do</code>
                   on the same line
                  as the expression, even if it is short.  Doing so makes it unclear that there
                  is relevant code there.  This is especially important for early returns.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">if</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>notReady</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">return</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>

</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">if</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>notReady</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span></span>

</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">while</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>condition</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span>i</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">+</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">1</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>

                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->

                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">if</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>notReady</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span></span>

                </div>
                <p>
                  Note that this rule can conflict with the
                  <a href="https://dart.dev/tools/dart-format">Dart formatter</a>, and should not be enabled
                  when the Dart formatter is used.
                </p>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>always_put_control_body_on_new_line</code> rule, add <code>always_put_control_body_on_new_line</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">always_put_control_body_on_new_line</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>always_put_control_body_on_new_line: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>

</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">always_<wbr/>put_<wbr/>required_<wbr/>named_<wbr/>parameters_<wbr/>first</h1>

                <p>Put required named parameters first.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>DO</strong> specify <code>required</code> on named parameter before other named parameters.</p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">m</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span><span>b</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">,</span><span> </span><span>c</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">,</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">required</span><span> </span><span>a</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>always_put_required_named_parameters_first</code> rule, add <code>always_put_required_named_parameters_first</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">always_put_required_named_parameters_first</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>always_put_required_named_parameters_first: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">always_put_required_named_parameters_first</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>

    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">always_<wbr/>require_<wbr/>non_<wbr/>null_<wbr/>named_<wbr/>parameters</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the always_require_non_null_named_parameters linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"always_require_non_null_named_parameters","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/always_require_non_null_named_parameters"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>
                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>
                          <li>
                            <button class="text-button"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">copy</span>Copy link</button>
                          </li>
                          <li>
                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/always_require_non_null_named_parameters"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>

                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label red" title="Lint has been removed." aria-label="Lint has been removed."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">error</span><span>Removed</span></div>
                </div>
                <p>Specify <code>@required</code> on named parameters without defaults.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>NOTE: This rule is removed in Dart 3.3.0; it is no longer functional.</p>
                <p>
                  <strong>DO</strong> specify <code>@required</code> on named parameters without a default value on which
                  an <code>assert(param != null)</code> is done.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">m1</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span><span>a</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">assert</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>a</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">!=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">null</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">m1</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">@required</span><span> </span><span>a</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">assert</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>a</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">!=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">null</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>

</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">m2</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span><span>a</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">1</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">assert</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>a</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">!=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">null</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>

                </div>
                <p>NOTE: Only asserts at the start of the bodies will be taken into account.</p>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>always_require_non_null_named_parameters</code> rule, add <code>always_require_non_null_named_parameters</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">always_require_non_null_named_parameters</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>always_require_non_null_named_parameters: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">always_require_non_null_named_parameters</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>

                  <h1 id="document-title">always_<wbr/>specify_<wbr/>types</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the always_specify_types linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"always_specify_types","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/always_specify_types"}-->

                <p>Specify type annotations.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>From the <a href="https://flutter.dev/style-guide/">style guide for the flutter repo</a>:</p>
                <p><strong>DO</strong> specify type annotations.</p>
                <p>
                  Avoid <code>var</code> when specifying that a type is unknown and short-hands that elide
                  type annotations.  Use <code>dynamic</code> if you are being explicit that the type is
                  unknown.  Use <code>Object</code> if you are being explicit that you want an object that
                  implements <code>==</code> and <code>hashCode</code>.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>

                <p>
                  NOTE: Using the <code>@optionalTypeArgs</code> annotation in the <code>meta</code> package, API
                  authors can special-case type parameters whose type needs to be dynamic but whose
                  declaration should be treated as optional.  For example, suppose you have a
                  <code>Key</code> object whose type parameter you'd like to treat as optional.  Using the
                  <code>@optionalTypeArgs</code> would look like this:
                </p>

                </div>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="incompatible-rules">Incompatible rules</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#incompatible-rules" aria-label="Link to 'Incompatible rules' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>The <code>always_specify_types</code> lint is incompatible with the following rules:</p>
                <ul>
                  <li>
                    <a href="/tools/linter-rules/avoid_types_on_closure_parameters"><code>avoid_types_on_closure_parameters</code></a>
                  </li>
                  <li><a href="/tools/linter-rules/omit_local_variable_types"><code>omit_local_variable_types</code></a></li>
                  <li>
                    <a href="/tools/linter-rules/omit_obvious_local_variable_types"><code>omit_obvious_local_variable_types</code></a>
                  </li>
                  <li>
                    <a href="/tools/linter-rules/omit_obvious_property_types"><code>omit_obvious_property_types</code></a>
                  </li>
                </ul>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>always_specify_types</code> rule, add <code>always_specify_types</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">always_specify_types</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>always_specify_types: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">always_specify_types</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  </nav>
                  <h1 id="document-title">always_<wbr/>use_<wbr/>package_<wbr/>imports</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the always_use_package_imports linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"always_use_package_imports","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/always_use_package_imports"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>
                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>
                          <li>
                            <button class="text-button"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">copy</span>Copy link</button>
                          </li>
                          <li>
                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/always_use_package_imports"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>
                          </li>
                        </ul>
                      </nav>
                    </div>

                  <!--/@page_header_options-->
                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint has one or more quick fixes available." aria-label="Lint has one or more quick fixes available.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">build</span>
                    <span>Fix available</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label grey" title="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.10." aria-label="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.10.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">merge_type</span>
                    <span>Released in Dart 2.10</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid relative imports for files in <code>lib/</code>.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>DO</strong> avoid relative imports for files in <code>lib/</code>.</p>
                <p>
                  When mixing relative and absolute imports it's possible to create confusion
                  where the same member gets imported in two different ways. One way to avoid
                  that is to ensure you consistently use absolute imports for files within the
                  <code>lib/</code> directory.
                </p>
                <p>This is the opposite of 'prefer_relative_imports'.</p>
                <p>
                  You can also use 'avoid_relative_lib_imports' to disallow relative imports of
                  files within <code>lib/</code> directory outside of it (for example <code>test/</code>).
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">import</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">baz.dart</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span style="user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none">​</span>

                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="incompatible-rules">Incompatible rules</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#incompatible-rules" aria-label="Link to 'Incompatible rules' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>The <code>always_use_package_imports</code> lint is incompatible with the following rules:</p>
                <ul>
                  <li><a href="/tools/linter-rules/prefer_relative_imports"><code>prefer_relative_imports</code></a></li>
                </ul>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>always_use_package_imports</code> rule, add <code>always_use_package_imports</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">always_use_package_imports</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>always_use_package_imports: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">always_use_package_imports</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->

                  <h1 id="document-title">annotate_<wbr/>overrides</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the annotate_overrides linter rule.</p>

                <p>Annotate overridden members.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>DO</strong> annotate overridden methods and fields.</p>
                <p>
                  This practice improves code readability and helps protect against
                  unintentionally overriding superclass members.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>annotate_overrides</code> rule, add <code>annotate_overrides</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">annotate_overrides</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>annotate_overrides: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">annotate_overrides</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->

                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the annotate_redeclares linter rule.</p>

                <p>Annotate redeclared members.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>DO</strong> annotate redeclared members.</p>
                <p>
                  This practice improves code readability and helps protect against
                  unintentionally redeclaring members or being surprised when a member ceases to
                  redeclare (due for example to a rename refactoring).
                </p>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>annotate_redeclares</code> rule, add <code>annotate_redeclares</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">annotate_redeclares</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>annotate_redeclares: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">async_<wbr/>return_<wbr/>with_<wbr/>no_<wbr/>await</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the async_return_with_no_await linter rule.</p>

                <p>Return with no await.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  <strong>DO</strong> use <code>await</code> when returning a <code>Future</code> from an <code>async</code>
                   function.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>

                  <div class="code-block-body">

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>async_return_with_no_await</code> rule, add <code>async_return_with_no_await</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">async_return_with_no_await</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>async_return_with_no_await: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">

</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>

    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>annotating_<wbr/>with_<wbr/>dynamic</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_annotating_with_dynamic linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_annotating_with_dynamic","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_annotating_with_dynamic"}-->

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>

                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint has one or more quick fixes available." aria-label="Lint has one or more quick fixes available.">

                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid annotating with <code>dynamic</code> when not required.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> annotating with <code>dynamic</code> when not required.</p>
                <p>
                  As <code>dynamic</code> is the assumed return value of a function or method, it is usually
                  not necessary to annotate it.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">dynamic</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">lookUpOrDefault</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">String</span><span> </span><span>name</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">,</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Map</span><span> </span><span>map</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">,</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">dynamic</span><span> </span><span>defaultValue</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">var</span><span> </span><span>value</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span>map</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">[</span><span>name</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">]</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">if</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>value</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">!=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">null</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">return</span><span> </span><span>value</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">return</span><span> </span><span>defaultValue</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span></code></pre>

                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">lookUpOrDefault</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">String</span><span> </span><span>name</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">,</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Map</span><span> </span><span>map</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">,</span><span> </span><span>defaultValue</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_annotating_with_dynamic</code> rule, add <code>avoid_annotating_with_dynamic</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_annotating_with_dynamic</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_annotating_with_dynamic: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">

                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_annotating_with_dynamic</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>as</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_as linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_as","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_as"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>
                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>
                          <li>
                            <button class="text-button"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">copy</span>Copy link</button>
                          </li>
                          <li>
                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_as"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>
                          </li>
                        </ul>
                      </nav>
