                  <!--/@page_header_options-->
                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label red" title="Lint has been removed." aria-label="Lint has been removed."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">error</span><span>Removed</span></div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid using <code>as</code>.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  NOTE: This rule was removed from the SDK in Dart 3; it is no longer functional.
                  Its advice is compiler-specific and mostly obsolete with null safety.
                </p>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> using <code>as</code>.</p>
                <p>
                  If you know the type is correct, use an assertion or assign to a more
                  narrowly-typed variable (this avoids the type check in release mode; <code>as</code>
                   is not
                  compiled out in release mode).  If you don't know whether the type is
                  correct, check using <code>is</code> (this avoids the exception that <code>as</code>
                   raises).
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>pm</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">as</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Person</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">.</span><span>firstName</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">Seth</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">if</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>pm</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">is</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Person</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span>pm</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">.</span><span>firstName</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">Seth</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>but certainly not</p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">try</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>   </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>pm</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">as</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Person</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">.</span><span>firstName</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">Seth</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">on</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">CastError</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  Note that an exception is made in the case of <code>dynamic</code> since the cast has no
                  performance impact.
                </p>
                <p><strong>OK:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">HasScrollDirection</span><span> </span><span>scrollable</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span>renderObject</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">as</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">dynamic</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_as</code> rule, add <code>avoid_as</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_as</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_as: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_as</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>bool_<wbr/>literals_<wbr/>in_<wbr/>conditional_<wbr/>expressions</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_bool_literals_in_conditional_expressions linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_bool_literals_in_conditional_expressions","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_bool_literals_in_conditional_expressions"}-->

                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">

                <p>Avoid <code>bool</code> literals in conditional expressions.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> <code>bool</code> literals in conditional expressions.</p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span>condition</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">?</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span>boolExpression</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>condition</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">?</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">false</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span>boolExpression</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>condition</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">?</span><span> </span><span>boolExpression</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>condition</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">?</span><span> </span><span>boolExpression</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">false</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span>condition</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">||</span><span> </span><span>boolExpression</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">!</span><span>condition</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">&amp;&amp;</span><span> </span><span>boolExpression</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">!</span><span>condition</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">||</span><span> </span><span>boolExpression</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>condition</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">&amp;&amp;</span><span> </span><span>boolExpression</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_bool_literals_in_conditional_expressions</code> rule, add <code>avoid_bool_literals_in_conditional_expressions</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_bool_literals_in_conditional_expressions</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_bool_literals_in_conditional_expressions: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_bool_literals_in_conditional_expressions</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>

      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>catches_<wbr/>without_<wbr/>on_<wbr/>clauses</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_catches_without_on_clauses linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_catches_without_on_clauses","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_catches_without_on_clauses"}-->

                <p>Avoid catches without on clauses.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  From <a href="https://dart.dev/effective-dart/usage#avoid-catches-without-on-clauses">Effective Dart</a>:
                </p>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> catches without on clauses.</p>
                <p>
                  Using catch clauses without on clauses make your code prone to encountering
                  unexpected errors that won't be thrown (and thus will go unnoticed).
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">try</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">somethingRisky</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>e</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">doSomething</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>e</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">try</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">somethingRisky</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">on</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Exception</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>e</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">doSomething</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>e</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>A few exceptional cases are allowed:</p>
                <ul>
                  <li>If the body of the catch rethrows the exception.</li>
                  <li>
                    If the caught exception is "directly used" in an argument to <code>Future.error</code>,
                    <code>Completer.completeError</code>, or <code>FlutterError.reportError</code>, or any function with
                    a return type of <code>Never</code>.
                  </li>
                  <li>If the caught exception is "directly used" in a new throw-expression.</li>
                </ul>
                <p>
                  In these cases, "directly used" means that the exception is referenced within
                  the relevant code (like within an argument). If the exception variable is
                  referenced <em>before</em> the relevant code, for example to instantiate a wrapper
                  exception, the variable is not "directly used."
                </p>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_catches_without_on_clauses</code> rule, add <code>avoid_catches_without_on_clauses</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>

                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_catches_without_on_clauses: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>catching_<wbr/>errors</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_catching_errors linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_catching_errors","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_catching_errors"}-->

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Don't explicitly catch <code>Error</code> or types that implement it.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>DON'T</strong> explicitly catch <code>Error</code> or types that implement it.</p>
                <p>
                  Errors differ from Exceptions in that Errors can be analyzed and prevented prior
                  to runtime.  It should almost never be necessary to catch an error at runtime.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">try</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">somethingRisky</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">on</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Error</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>e</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">doSomething</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>e</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">try</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_catching_errors</code> rule, add <code>avoid_catching_errors</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_catching_errors</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_catching_errors: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>classes_<wbr/>with_<wbr/>only_<wbr/>static_<wbr/>members</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_classes_with_only_static_members linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_classes_with_only_static_members","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_classes_with_only_static_members"}-->

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid defining a class that contains only static members.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  From <a href="https://dart.dev/effective-dart/design#avoid-defining-a-class-that-contains-only-static-members">Effective Dart</a>:
                </p>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> defining a class that contains only static members.</p>
                <p>
                  Creating classes with the sole purpose of providing utility or otherwise static
                  methods is discouraged.  Dart allows functions to exist outside of classes for
                  this very reason.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">

                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_classes_with_only_static_members</code> rule, add <code>avoid_classes_with_only_static_members</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_classes_with_only_static_members</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_classes_with_only_static_members: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_classes_with_only_static_members</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>double_<wbr/>and_<wbr/>int_<wbr/>checks</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_double_and_int_checks linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_double_and_int_checks","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_double_and_int_checks"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>
                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>
                          <li>
                            <button class="text-button"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">copy</span>Copy link</button>
                          </li>
                          <li>
                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_double_and_int_checks"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>

                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid <code>double</code> and <code>int</code> checks.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> to check if type is <code>double</code> or <code>int</code>.</p>
                <p>
                  When compiled to JS, integer values are represented as floats. That can lead to
                  some unexpected behavior when using either <code>is</code> or <code>is!</code> where the type is
                  either <code>int</code> or <code>double</code>.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">f</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">num</span><span> </span><span>x</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>

</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">else</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">if</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>x</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">is</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">int</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">...</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span></code></pre>

                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">f</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">dynamic</span><span> </span><span>x</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_double_and_int_checks</code> rule, add <code>avoid_double_and_int_checks</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_double_and_int_checks</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_double_and_int_checks: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_double_and_int_checks</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>dynamic_<wbr/>calls</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_dynamic_calls linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_dynamic_calls","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_dynamic_calls"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>
                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>
                          <li>
                            <button class="text-button"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">copy</span>Copy link</button>
                          </li>
                          <li>
                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_dynamic_calls"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>
                          </li>
                        </ul>
                      </nav>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <!--/@page_header_options-->
                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label grey" title="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.12." aria-label="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.12.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">merge_type</span>
                    <span>Released in Dart 2.12</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid method calls or property accesses on a <code>dynamic</code> target.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  <strong>DO</strong> avoid method calls or accessing properties on an object that is either
                  explicitly or implicitly statically typed <code>dynamic</code>. Dynamic calls are treated
                  slightly different in every runtime environment and compiler, but most
                  production modes (and even some development modes) have both compile size and
                  runtime performance penalties associated with dynamic calls.
                </p>
                <p>
                  Additionally, targets typed <code>dynamic</code> disables most static analysis, meaning it
                  is easier to lead to a runtime <code>NoSuchMethodError</code> or <code>TypeError</code>
                   than properly
                  statically typed Dart code.
                </p>
                <p>There is an exception to methods and properties that exist on <code>Object?</code>:</p>
                <ul>
                  <li><code>a.hashCode</code></li>
                  <li><code>a.runtimeType</code></li>
                  <li><code>a.noSuchMethod(someInvocation)</code></li>
                  <li><code>a.toString()</code></li>
                </ul>
                <p>
                  ... these members are dynamically dispatched in the web-based runtimes, but not
                  in the VM-based ones. Additionally, they are so common that it would be very
                  punishing to disallow <code>any.toString()</code> or <code>any == true</code>, for example.
                </p>
                <p>
                  Note that despite <code>Function</code> being a type, the semantics are close to identical
                  to <code>dynamic</code>, and calls to an object that is typed <code>Function</code>
                   will also trigger
                  this lint.
                </p>
                <p>Dynamic calls are allowed on cast expressions (<code>as dynamic</code> or <code>as Function</code>).</p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_dynamic_calls</code> rule, add <code>avoid_dynamic_calls</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_dynamic_calls</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_dynamic_calls: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_dynamic_calls</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>empty_<wbr/>else</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_empty_else linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_empty_else","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_empty_else"}-->

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint is included in the core set of rules." aria-label="Lint is included in the core set of rules."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">circles</span><span>Core</span></div>
                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint has one or more quick fixes available." aria-label="Lint has one or more quick fixes available.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">build</span>

                <p>Avoid empty statements in else clauses.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  <strong>AVOID</strong> empty statements in the <code>else</code> clause of <code>if</code> statements.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">if</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>x</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&gt;</span><span> </span><span>y</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">print</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">1</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">else</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">print</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">2</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you want a statement that follows the empty clause to <em>conditionally</em> run,
                  remove the dangling semicolon to include it in the <code>else</code> clause.
                  Optionally, also enclose the else's statement in a block.
                </p>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">if</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>x</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&gt;</span><span> </span><span>y</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">print</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">1</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">else</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">print</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">2</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>

                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">if</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>x</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&gt;</span><span> </span><span>y</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">print</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">1</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">else</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">print</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">2</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you want a statement that follows the empty clause to <em>unconditionally</em> run,
                  remove the <code>else</code> clause.
                </p>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_empty_else</code> rule, add <code>avoid_empty_else</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_empty_else</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_empty_else: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>

    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>equals_<wbr/>and_<wbr/>hash_<wbr/>code_<wbr/>on_<wbr/>mutable_<wbr/>classes</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_equals_and_hash_code_on_mutable_classes linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_equals_and_hash_code_on_mutable_classes","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_equals_and_hash_code_on_mutable_classes"}-->
