                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label grey" title="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.6." aria-label="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.6.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">merge_type</span>
                    <span>Released in Dart 2.6</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid overloading operator == and hashCode on classes not marked <code>@immutable</code>.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  From <a href="https://dart.dev/effective-dart/design#avoid-defining-custom-equality-for-mutable-classes">Effective Dart</a>:
                </p>
                <p>
                  <strong>AVOID</strong> overloading operator == and hashCode on classes not marked <code>@immutable</code>.
                </p>
                <p>
                  If a class is not immutable, overloading <code>operator ==</code> and <code>hashCode</code> can
                  lead to unpredictable and undesirable behavior when used in collections.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>

                <p>
                  NOTE: The lint checks the use of the <code>@immutable</code> annotation, and will trigger
                  even if the class is otherwise not mutable. Thus:
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_equals_and_hash_code_on_mutable_classes</code> rule, add <code>avoid_equals_and_hash_code_on_mutable_classes</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_equals_and_hash_code_on_mutable_classes</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_equals_and_hash_code_on_mutable_classes: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_escaping_inner_quotes linter rule.</p>

                <p>Avoid escaping inner quotes by converting surrounding quotes.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid escaping inner quotes by converting surrounding quotes.</p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">var</span><span> </span><span>s</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">It</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">\'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">s not fun</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>

                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">

                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">var</span><span> </span><span>s</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">"</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">It's not fun</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">"</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_escaping_inner_quotes</code> rule, add <code>avoid_escaping_inner_quotes</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>

                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_escaping_inner_quotes: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>field_<wbr/>initializers_<wbr/>in_<wbr/>const_<wbr/>classes</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_field_initializers_in_const_classes linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_field_initializers_in_const_classes","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_field_initializers_in_const_classes"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">

                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_field_initializers_in_const_classes"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>

                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid field initializers in const classes.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> field initializers in const classes.</p>
                <p>
                  Instead of <code>final x = const expr;</code>, you should write <code>get x =&gt; const expr;</code> and
                  not allocate a useless field. As of April 2018 this is true for the VM, but not
                  for code that will be compiled to JS.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">class</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">A</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">final</span><span> </span><span>a</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">const</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">[</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">]</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">const</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">A</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">class</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">A</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_field_initializers_in_const_classes</code> rule, add <code>avoid_field_initializers_in_const_classes</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_field_initializers_in_const_classes</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_field_initializers_in_const_classes: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>final_<wbr/>parameters</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_final_parameters linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_final_parameters","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_final_parameters"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>
                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>
                          <li>
                            <button class="text-button"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">copy</span>Copy link</button>

                          <li>
                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_final_parameters"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint has one or more quick fixes available." aria-label="Lint has one or more quick fixes available.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">build</span>
                    <span>Fix available</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label grey" title="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.16." aria-label="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.16.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">merge_type</span>
                    <span>Released in Dart 2.16</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid <code>final</code> for parameter declarations.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> declaring parameters as <code>final</code>.</p>
                <p>
                  Declaring parameters as <code>final</code> can lead to unnecessarily verbose code,
                  especially when using the "parameter_assignments" rule.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>

                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="incompatible-rules">Incompatible rules</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#incompatible-rules" aria-label="Link to 'Incompatible rules' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>The <code>avoid_final_parameters</code> lint is incompatible with the following rules:</p>
                <ul>
                  <li><a href="/tools/linter-rules/prefer_final_parameters"><code>prefer_final_parameters</code></a></li>
                </ul>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_final_parameters</code> rule, add <code>avoid_final_parameters</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_final_parameters</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_final_parameters: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_final_parameters</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>function_<wbr/>literals_<wbr/>in_<wbr/>foreach_<wbr/>calls</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_function_literals_in_foreach_calls linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_function_literals_in_foreach_calls","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_function_literals_in_foreach_calls"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>

                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint is included in the recommended set of rules." aria-label="Lint is included in the recommended set of rules.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">thumb_up</span>

                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint has one or more quick fixes available." aria-label="Lint has one or more quick fixes available.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">build</span>
                    <span>Fix available</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid using <code>forEach</code> with a function literal.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> using <code>forEach</code> with a function literal.</p>
                <p>
                  The <code>for</code> loop enables a developer to be clear and explicit as to their intent.
                  A return in the body of the <code>for</code> loop returns from the body of the function,
                  where as a return in the body of the <code>forEach</code> closure only returns a value
                  for that iteration of the <code>forEach</code>. The body of a <code>for</code> loop can contain
                  <code>await</code>s, while the closure body of a <code>forEach</code> cannot.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span>people</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">.</span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">forEach</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>person</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">...</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">for</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">var</span><span> </span><span>person</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">in</span><span> </span><span>people</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">...</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_function_literals_in_foreach_calls</code> rule, add <code>avoid_function_literals_in_foreach_calls</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_function_literals_in_foreach_calls</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_function_literals_in_foreach_calls: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_function_literals_in_foreach_calls</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>futureor_<wbr/>void</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_futureor_void linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_futureor_void","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_futureor_void"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>
                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>

                            <button class="text-button"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">copy</span>Copy link</button>
                          </li>
                          <li>
                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_futureor_void"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>
                          </li>

                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label orange" title="Lint is experimental." aria-label="Lint is experimental.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">science</span>
                    <span>Experimental</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label grey" title="This lint was originally available in Dart 3.6." aria-label="This lint was originally available in Dart 3.6.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">merge_type</span>
                    <span>Released in Dart 3.6</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid using 'FutureOr<void>' as the type of a result.</void></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  <strong>AVOID</strong> using <code>FutureOr&lt;void&gt;</code> as the type of a result. This type is
                  problematic because it may appear to encode that a result is either a
                  <code>Future&lt;void&gt;</code>, or the result should be discarded (when it is <code>void</code>).
                  However, there is no safe way to detect whether we have one or the other
                  case (because an expression of type <code>void</code> can evaluate to any object
                  whatsoever, including a future of any type).
                </p>
                <p>
                  It is also conceptually unsound to have a type whose meaning is something
                  like "ignore this object; also, take a look because it might be a future".
                </p>
                <p>
                  An exception is made for contravariant occurrences of the type
                  <code>FutureOr&lt;void&gt;</code> (e.g., for the type of a formal parameter), and no
                  warning is emitted for these occurrences. The reason for this exception
                  is that the type does not describe a result, it describes a constraint
                  on a value provided by others. Similarly, an exception is made for type
                  alias declarations, because they may well be used in a contravariant
                  position (e.g., as the type of a formal parameter). Hence, in type alias
                  declarations, only the type parameter bounds are checked.
                </p>
                <p>
                  A replacement for the type <code>FutureOr&lt;void&gt;</code> which is often useful is
                  <code>Future&lt;void&gt;?</code>. This type encodes that the result is either a
                  <code>Future&lt;void&gt;</code> or it is null, and there is no ambiguity at run time
                  since no object can have both types.
                </p>
                <p>
                  It may not always be possible to use the type <code>Future&lt;void&gt;?</code> as a
                  replacement for the type <code>FutureOr&lt;void&gt;</code>, because the latter is a
                  supertype of all types, and the former is not. In this case it may be a
                  useful remedy to replace <code>FutureOr&lt;void&gt;</code> by the type <code>void</code>.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">FutureOr</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">void</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&gt;</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">m</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">...</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span></code></pre>

                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Future</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">void</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">?</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">m</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">...</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>

                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  <strong>This rule is experimental.</strong>
                  It is being evaluated, and it might be changed or removed.
                  Feedback on its behavior is welcome! The primary relevant issue is
                  <a href="https://github.com/dart-lang/sdk/issues/59232">dart-lang/sdk#59292</a>.
                </p>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_futureor_void</code> rule, add <code>avoid_futureor_void</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_futureor_void</span></span>
</span></code></pre>

                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>

                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_futureor_void: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                        <a property="item" typeof="WebPage" href="/tools/linter-rules/avoid_implementing_value_types"><span property="name">avoid_implementing_value_types</span></a><meta property="position" content="2"/>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>implementing_<wbr/>value_<wbr/>types</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_implementing_value_types linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_implementing_value_types","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_implementing_value_types"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>
                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>
                          <li>
                            <button class="text-button"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">copy</span>Copy link</button>
                          </li>
                          <li>
                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_implementing_value_types"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>
                          </li>
                        </ul>
                      </nav>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <!--/@page_header_options-->
                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label grey" title="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.1." aria-label="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.1.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">merge_type</span>
                    <span>Released in Dart 2.1</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Don't implement classes that override <code>==</code>.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>DON'T</strong> implement classes that override <code>==</code>.</p>
                <p>
                  The <code>==</code> operator is contractually required to be an equivalence relation;
                  that is, symmetrically for all objects <code>o1</code> and <code>o2</code>, <code>o1 == o2</code>
                   and <code>o2 == o1</code>
                  must either both be true, or both be false.
                </p>
                <blockquote>
                  <p>
                    <em>NOTE</em>: Dart does not have true <em>value types</em>, so instead we consider a class
                    that implements <code>==</code>  as a <em>proxy</em> for identifying value types.
                  </p>
                </blockquote>
                <p>
                  When using <code>implements</code>, you do not inherit the method body of <code>==</code>, making it
                  nearly impossible to follow the contract of <code>==</code>. Classes that override 
                  <code>==</code>
                  typically are usable directly in tests <em>without</em> creating mocks or fakes as
                  well. For example, for a given class <code>Size</code>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">class</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Size</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">final</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">int</span><span> </span><span>inBytes</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">const</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Size</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">this</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">.</span><span>inBytes</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_implementing_value_types</code> rule, add <code>avoid_implementing_value_types</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_implementing_value_types</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_implementing_value_types: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>

</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>

    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>init_<wbr/>to_<wbr/>null</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_init_to_null linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_init_to_null","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_init_to_null"}-->

                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint has one or more quick fixes available." aria-label="Lint has one or more quick fixes available.">

                <p>Don't explicitly initialize variables to <code>null</code>.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  From <a href="https://dart.dev/effective-dart/usage#dont-explicitly-initialize-variables-to-null">Effective Dart</a>:
                </p>
                <p><strong>DON'T</strong> explicitly initialize variables to <code>null</code>.</p>
                <p>
                  If a variable has a non-nullable type or is <code>final</code>,
                  Dart reports a compile error if you try to use it
                  before it has been definitely initialized.
                  If the variable is nullable and not <code>const</code> or <code>final</code>,
                  then it is implicitly initialized to <code>null</code> for you.
                  There's no concept of "uninitialized memory" in Dart
                  and no need to explicitly initialize a variable to <code>null</code> to be "safe".
                  Adding <code>= null</code> is redundant and unneeded.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_init_to_null</code> rule, add <code>avoid_init_to_null</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_init_to_null</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_init_to_null: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>

                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>

</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_init_to_null</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>js_<wbr/>rounded_<wbr/>ints</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_js_rounded_ints linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_js_rounded_ints","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_js_rounded_ints"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>
                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>

                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_js_rounded_ints"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid JavaScript rounded ints.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  <strong>AVOID</strong> integer literals that cannot be represented exactly when compiled to
                  JavaScript.
                </p>
                <p>
                  When a program is compiled to JavaScript <code>int</code> and <code>double</code> become JavaScript
                  Numbers. Too large integers (<code>value &lt; Number.MIN_SAFE_INTEGER</code> or
                  <code>value &gt; Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER</code>) may be rounded to the closest Number value.
                </p>
                <p>
                  For instance <code>1000000000000000001</code> cannot be represented exactly as a JavaScript
                  Number, so <code>1000000000000000000</code> will be used instead.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">int</span><span> </span><span>value</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">9007199254740995</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">BigInt</span><span> </span><span>value</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">BigInt</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">.</span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">parse</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">9007199254740995</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_js_rounded_ints</code> rule, add <code>avoid_js_rounded_ints</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_js_rounded_ints</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_js_rounded_ints: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_js_rounded_ints</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>multiple_<wbr/>declarations_<wbr/>per_<wbr/>line</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_multiple_declarations_per_line linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_multiple_declarations_per_line","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_multiple_declarations_per_line"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>
                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>

                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_multiple_declarations_per_line"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint has one or more quick fixes available." aria-label="Lint has one or more quick fixes available.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">build</span>
                    <span>Fix available</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label grey" title="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.13." aria-label="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.13.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">merge_type</span>
                    <span>Released in Dart 2.13</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Don't declare multiple variables on a single line.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>DON'T</strong> declare multiple variables on a single line.</p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">String</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">?</span><span> </span><span>foo</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">,</span><span> </span><span>bar</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">,</span><span> </span><span>baz</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">String</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">?</span><span> </span><span>foo</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">String</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">?</span><span> </span><span>bar</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">String</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">?</span><span> </span><span>baz</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_multiple_declarations_per_line</code> rule, add <code>avoid_multiple_declarations_per_line</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_multiple_declarations_per_line</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_multiple_declarations_per_line: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_multiple_declarations_per_line</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
