                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>null_<wbr/>checks_<wbr/>in_<wbr/>equality_<wbr/>operators</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_null_checks_in_equality_operators linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_null_checks_in_equality_operators","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_null_checks_in_equality_operators"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">

                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>

                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_null_checks_in_equality_operators"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>

                  <!--/@page_header_options-->
                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label orange" title="Lint is deprecated." aria-label="Lint is deprecated.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">report</span>
                    <span>Deprecated</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint has one or more quick fixes available." aria-label="Lint has one or more quick fixes available.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">build</span>
                    <span>Fix available</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Don't check for <code>null</code> in custom <code>==</code> operators.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  <strong>NOTE:</strong> This lint has been replaced by the
                  <code>non_nullable_equals_parameter</code> warning and is deprecated.
                  Remove all inclusions of this lint from your analysis options.
                </p>
                <p><strong>DON'T</strong> check for <code>null</code> in custom <code>==</code> operators.</p>
                <p>
                  As <code>null</code> is a special value, no instance of any class (other than <code>Null</code>) can
                  be equivalent to it.  Thus, it is redundant to check whether the other instance
                  is <code>null</code>.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>

                  <div class="code-block-body">

                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">

                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">class</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Person</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>

</span><span class="line"><span style="user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none">​</span>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_null_checks_in_equality_operators</code> rule, add <code>avoid_null_checks_in_equality_operators</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_null_checks_in_equality_operators</span></span>

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>positional_<wbr/>boolean_<wbr/>parameters</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_positional_boolean_parameters linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_positional_boolean_parameters","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_positional_boolean_parameters"}-->

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid positional boolean parameters.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  From <a href="https://dart.dev/effective-dart/design#avoid-positional-boolean-parameters">Effective Dart</a>:
                </p>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> positional boolean parameters.</p>
                <p>
                  Positional boolean parameters are a bad practice because they are very
                  ambiguous.  Using named boolean parameters is much more readable because it
                  inherently describes what the boolean value represents.
                </p>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_positional_boolean_parameters</code> rule, add <code>avoid_positional_boolean_parameters</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_positional_boolean_parameters</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_positional_boolean_parameters: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">

    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>print</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_print linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_print","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_print"}-->

                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">

                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint is included in the Flutter set of rules." aria-label="Lint is included in the Flutter set of rules."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">flutter</span><span>Flutter</span></div>

                  <div class="tag-label grey" title="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.5." aria-label="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.5.">

                <p>Avoid <code>print</code> calls in production code.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>DO</strong> avoid <code>print</code> calls in production code.</p>
                <p>
                  For production code, consider using a logging framework.
                  If you are using Flutter, you can use <code>debugPrint</code>
                  or surround <code>print</code> calls with a check for <code>kDebugMode</code>
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_print</code> rule, add <code>avoid_print</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_print</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_print: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_print</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>private_<wbr/>typedef_<wbr/>functions</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_private_typedef_functions linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_private_typedef_functions","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_private_typedef_functions"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">

                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label orange" title="Lint is deprecated." aria-label="Lint is deprecated.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">report</span>
                    <span>Deprecated</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint has one or more quick fixes available." aria-label="Lint has one or more quick fixes available.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">build</span>
                    <span>Fix available</span>

                </div>
                <p>Avoid private typedef functions.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  <strong>NOTE:</strong> As a private typedef can make some code more readable,
                  this lint rule has been deprecated as of Dart 3.13 and is
                  set to be removed in a future release of the Dart SDK.
                  Remove all inclusions of this lint from your analysis options.
                  If you wish to keep enforcing it, consider implementing the
                  rule with an <a href="https://dart.dev/tools/analyzer-plugins">analyzer plugin</a>.
                </p>
                <p>
                  <strong>AVOID</strong> private typedef functions used only once. Prefer inline function
                  syntax.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">typedef</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">void</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">_F</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">m</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>_F</span><span> </span><span>f</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">m</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">void</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Function</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span>f</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_private_typedef_functions</code> rule, add <code>avoid_private_typedef_functions</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_private_typedef_functions</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_private_typedef_functions: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_private_typedef_functions</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>redundant_<wbr/>argument_<wbr/>values</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_redundant_argument_values linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_redundant_argument_values","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_redundant_argument_values"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">

                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">

                          </li>
                          <li>
                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_redundant_argument_values"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>
                          </li>

                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint has one or more quick fixes available." aria-label="Lint has one or more quick fixes available.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">build</span>
                    <span>Fix available</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label grey" title="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.8." aria-label="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.8.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">merge_type</span>
                    <span>Released in Dart 2.8</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid redundant argument values.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  <strong>DON'T</strong> pass an argument that matches the corresponding parameter's default
                  value.
                </p>
                <p>
                  Note that a method override can change the default value of a parameter, so that
                  an argument may be equal to one default value, and not the other. Take, for
                  example, two classes, <code>A</code> and <code>B</code> where <code>B</code> is a subclass of 
                  <code>A</code>, and <code>B</code>
                  overrides a method declared on <code>A</code>, and that method has a parameter with one
                  default value in <code>A</code>'s declaration, and a different default value in <code>B</code>'s
                  declaration. If the static type of the target of the invoked method is <code>B</code>, and
                  <code>B</code>'s default value matches the argument, then the argument can be omitted (and
                  if the argument value is different, then a lint is not reported). If, however,
                  the static type of the target of the invoked method is <code>A</code>, then a lint may be
                  reported, but we cannot know statically which method is invoked, so the reported
                  lint may be a false positive. Such cases can be ignored inline with a comment
                  like <code>// ignore: avoid_redundant_argument_values</code>.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">void</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">f</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">bool</span><span> </span><span>valWithDefault</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">,</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">bool</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">?</span><span> </span><span>val</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">...</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_redundant_argument_values</code> rule, add <code>avoid_redundant_argument_values</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_redundant_argument_values</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_redundant_argument_values: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>

</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_redundant_argument_values</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>relative_<wbr/>lib_<wbr/>imports</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_relative_lib_imports linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_relative_lib_imports","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_relative_lib_imports"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>

                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint is included in the core set of rules." aria-label="Lint is included in the core set of rules."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">circles</span><span>Core</span></div>
                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint has one or more quick fixes available." aria-label="Lint has one or more quick fixes available.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">build</span>
                    <span>Fix available</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid relative imports for files in <code>lib/</code>.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>DO</strong> avoid relative imports for files in <code>lib/</code>.</p>
                <p>
                  When mixing relative and absolute imports it's possible to create confusion
                  where the same member gets imported in two different ways.  An easy way to avoid
                  that is to ensure you have no relative imports that include <code>lib/</code> in their
                  paths.
                </p>
                <p>
                  You can also use 'always_use_package_imports' to disallow relative imports
                  between files within <code>lib/</code>.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">import</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">package:foo/bar.dart</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span style="user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none">​</span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">import</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">../lib/baz.dart</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span style="user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none">​</span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">...</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">import</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">package:foo/bar.dart</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span style="user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none">​</span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">import</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">baz.dart</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span style="user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none">​</span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">...</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_relative_lib_imports</code> rule, add <code>avoid_relative_lib_imports</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_relative_lib_imports</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_relative_lib_imports: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_relative_lib_imports</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>

      );

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>renaming_<wbr/>method_<wbr/>parameters</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_renaming_method_parameters linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_renaming_method_parameters","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_renaming_method_parameters"}-->

                <p>Don't rename parameters of overridden methods.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>DON'T</strong> rename parameters of overridden methods.</p>
                <p>
                  Methods that override another method, but do not have their own documentation
                  comment, will inherit the overridden method's comment when <code>dart doc</code> produces
                  documentation. If the inherited method contains the name of the parameter (in
                  square brackets), then <code>dart doc</code> cannot link it correctly.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">abstract</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">class</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">A</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">m</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>a</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span style="user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none">​</span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">abstract</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">class</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">B</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">extends</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">A</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">m</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>b</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->

                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">abstract</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">class</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">A</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>

</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">abstract</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">class</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">B</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">extends</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">A</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_renaming_method_parameters</code> rule, add <code>avoid_renaming_method_parameters</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_renaming_method_parameters</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_renaming_method_parameters: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_renaming_method_parameters</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>return_<wbr/>types_<wbr/>on_<wbr/>setters</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_return_types_on_setters linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_return_types_on_setters","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_return_types_on_setters"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>

                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>

                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint is included in the recommended set of rules." aria-label="Lint is included in the recommended set of rules.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">thumb_up</span>

                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint has one or more quick fixes available." aria-label="Lint has one or more quick fixes available.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">build</span>
                    <span>Fix available</span>

                </div>
                <p>Avoid return types on setters.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> return types on setters.</p>
                <p>As setters do not return a value, declaring the return type of one is redundant.</p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">void</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">set</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">speed</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">int</span><span> </span><span>ms</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">set</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">speed</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">int</span><span> </span><span>ms</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_return_types_on_setters</code> rule, add <code>avoid_return_types_on_setters</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_return_types_on_setters</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_return_types_on_setters: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_return_types_on_setters</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>returning_<wbr/>null</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_returning_null linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_returning_null","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_returning_null"}-->

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label red" title="Lint has been removed." aria-label="Lint has been removed."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">error</span><span>Removed</span></div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid returning null from members whose return type is bool, double, int, or num.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>NOTE: This rule is removed in Dart 3.3.0; it is no longer functional.</p>
                <p>
                  <strong>AVOID</strong> returning null from members whose return type is bool, double, int,
                  or num.
                </p>
                <p>
                  Functions that return primitive types such as bool, double, int, and num are
                  generally expected to return non-nullable values.  Thus, returning null where a
                  primitive type was expected can lead to runtime exceptions.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_returning_null</code> rule, add <code>avoid_returning_null</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_returning_null</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_returning_null: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>returning_<wbr/>null_<wbr/>for_<wbr/>future</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_returning_null_for_future linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_returning_null_for_future","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_returning_null_for_future"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>
                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>
                          <li>
                            <button class="text-button"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">copy</span>Copy link</button>
                          </li>
                          <li>
                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_returning_null_for_future"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>
                          </li>

                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label red" title="Lint has been removed." aria-label="Lint has been removed."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">error</span><span>Removed</span></div>
                  <div class="tag-label grey" title="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.1." aria-label="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.1.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">merge_type</span>
                    <span>Released in Dart 2.1</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid returning null for Future.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>NOTE: This rule is removed in Dart 3.3.0; it is no longer functional.</p>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> returning null for Future.</p>
                <p>
                  It is almost always wrong to return <code>null</code> for a <code>Future</code>.  Most of the time the
                  developer simply forgot to put an <code>async</code> keyword on the function.
                </p>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_returning_null_for_future</code> rule, add <code>avoid_returning_null_for_future</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_returning_null_for_future</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_returning_null_for_future: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>returning_<wbr/>null_<wbr/>for_<wbr/>void</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_returning_null_for_void linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_returning_null_for_void","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_returning_null_for_void"}-->

                <p>Avoid returning <code>null</code> for <code>void</code>.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> returning <code>null</code> for <code>void</code>.</p>
                <p>
                  In a large variety of languages <code>void</code> as return type is used to indicate that
                  a function doesn't return anything. Dart allows returning <code>null</code> in functions
                  with <code>void</code> return type but it also allow using <code>return;</code> without specifying any
                  value. To have a consistent way you should not return <code>null</code> and only use an
                  empty return.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">void</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">f1</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">return</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">null</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>

</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">return</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">null</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>

                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
