                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_returning_null_for_void</code> rule, add <code>avoid_returning_null_for_void</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_returning_null_for_void</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_returning_null_for_void: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>

      );

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>returning_<wbr/>this</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_returning_this linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_returning_this","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_returning_this"}-->

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid returning this from methods just to enable a fluent interface.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  From <a href="https://dart.dev/effective-dart/design#avoid-returning-this-from-methods-just-to-enable-a-fluent-interface">Effective Dart</a>:
                </p>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> returning this from methods just to enable a fluent interface.</p>
                <p>
                  Returning <code>this</code> from a method is redundant; Dart has a cascade operator which
                  allows method chaining universally.
                </p>
                <p>Returning <code>this</code> is allowed for:</p>
                <ul>
                  <li>operators</li>
                  <li>methods with a return type different of the current class</li>
                  <li>methods defined in parent classes / mixins or interfaces</li>
                  <li>methods defined in extensions</li>
                </ul>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">var</span><span> </span><span>buffer</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">StringBuffer</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span></span>

</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">.</span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">write</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">three</span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">'</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>

                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_returning_this</code> rule, add <code>avoid_returning_this</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_returning_this</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_returning_this: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>setters_<wbr/>without_<wbr/>getters</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_setters_without_getters linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_setters_without_getters","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_setters_without_getters"}-->

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">

                <p>Avoid setters without getters.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>DON'T</strong> define a setter without a corresponding getter.</p>
                <p>
                  Defining a setter without defining a corresponding getter can lead to logical
                  inconsistencies.  Doing this could allow you to set a property to some value,
                  but then upon observing the property's value, it could easily be different.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">class</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Bad</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">int</span><span> </span><span>l</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">,</span><span> </span><span>r</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span style="user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none">​</span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">set</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">length</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">int</span><span> </span><span>newLength</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>r</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span>l</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">+</span><span> </span><span>newLength</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">class</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Good</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">int</span><span> </span><span>l</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">,</span><span> </span><span>r</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span style="user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none">​</span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">int</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">get</span><span> </span><span>length</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=&gt;</span><span> </span><span>r</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">-</span><span> </span><span>l</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span style="user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none">​</span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">set</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">length</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">int</span><span> </span><span>newLength</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>r</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span>l</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">+</span><span> </span><span>newLength</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>

</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_setters_without_getters</code> rule, add <code>avoid_setters_without_getters</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_setters_without_getters</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_setters_without_getters: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_setters_without_getters</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>shadowing_<wbr/>type_<wbr/>parameters</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_shadowing_type_parameters linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_shadowing_type_parameters","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_shadowing_type_parameters"}-->

                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">merge_type</span>
                    <span>Released in Dart 2.1</span>

                <p>Avoid shadowing type parameters.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> shadowing type parameters.</p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">class</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">A</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">T</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&gt;</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">void</span><span> </span><span>fn</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">T</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>
</span></code></pre>

                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">class</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">A</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">T</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&gt;</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">void</span><span> </span><span>fn</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">U</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">}</span></span>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_shadowing_type_parameters</code> rule, add <code>avoid_shadowing_type_parameters</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_shadowing_type_parameters</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_shadowing_type_parameters: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_shadowing_type_parameters</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>single_<wbr/>cascade_<wbr/>in_<wbr/>expression_<wbr/>statements</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_single_cascade_in_expression_statements linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_single_cascade_in_expression_statements","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_single_cascade_in_expression_statements"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>

                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_single_cascade_in_expression_statements"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">

                <p>Avoid single cascade in expression statements.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> single cascade in expression statements.</p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span>o</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">..</span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">m</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span>o</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">.</span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">m</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_single_cascade_in_expression_statements</code> rule, add <code>avoid_single_cascade_in_expression_statements</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_single_cascade_in_expression_statements</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_single_cascade_in_expression_statements: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_single_cascade_in_expression_statements</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>slow_<wbr/>async_<wbr/>io</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_slow_async_io linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_slow_async_io","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_slow_async_io"}-->

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid slow asynchronous <code>dart:io</code> methods.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  <strong>AVOID</strong> using the following asynchronous file I/O methods because they are
                  much slower than their synchronous counterparts.
                </p>
                <ul>
                  <li><code>Directory.exists</code></li>
                  <li><code>Directory.stat</code></li>
                  <li><code>File.lastModified</code></li>
                  <li><code>File.exists</code></li>
                  <li><code>File.stat</code></li>
                  <li><code>FileSystemEntity.isDirectory</code></li>
                  <li><code>FileSystemEntity.isFile</code></li>
                  <li><code>FileSystemEntity.isLink</code></li>
                  <li><code>FileSystemEntity.type</code></li>
                </ul>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">

                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_slow_async_io</code> rule, add <code>avoid_slow_async_io</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_slow_async_io</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_slow_async_io: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>

                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_slow_async_io</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>

    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>type_<wbr/>to_<wbr/>string</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_type_to_string linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_type_to_string","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_type_to_string"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>
                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">
                      <nav class="dropdown-menu" role="menu">
                        <ul>

                          <li>
                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_type_to_string"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>

                  <!--/@page_header_options-->
                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label grey" title="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.12." aria-label="This lint was originally available in Dart 2.12.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">merge_type</span>
                    <span>Released in Dart 2.12</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid <type>.toString() in production code since results may be minified.</type></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  <strong>DO</strong> avoid calls to <type>.toString() in production code, since it does not
                    contractually return the user-defined name of the Type (or underlying class).
                    Development-mode compilers where code size is not a concern use the full name,
                    but release-mode compilers often choose to minify these symbols.</type>
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_type_to_string</code> rule, add <code>avoid_type_to_string</code> under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_type_to_string</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_type_to_string: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_type_to_string</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>types_<wbr/>as_<wbr/>parameter_<wbr/>names</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_types_as_parameter_names linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_types_as_parameter_names","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_types_as_parameter_names"}-->

                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint is included in the core set of rules." aria-label="Lint is included in the core set of rules."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">circles</span><span>Core</span></div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid types as parameter names.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> using a parameter name that is the same as an existing type.</p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">m</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">f</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">int</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">m</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">f</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">int</span><span> </span><span>v</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_types_as_parameter_names</code> rule, add <code>avoid_types_as_parameter_names</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_types_as_parameter_names</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_types_as_parameter_names: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_types_as_parameter_names</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->

    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>types_<wbr/>on_<wbr/>closure_<wbr/>parameters</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_types_on_closure_parameters linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_types_on_closure_parameters","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_types_on_closure_parameters"}-->
                  <div id="page-header-options" class="dropdown" data-expanded="false">
                    <button class="dropdown-button text-button icon-button" aria-controls="page-header-options-content" aria-expanded="false" title="View page options."><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">more_vert</span></button>
                    <div id="page-header-options-content" class="dropdown-content">

                            <a class="text-button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_types_on_closure_parameters"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">bug_report</span>Report issue</a>

                </header>
                <div class="tags">
                  <div class="tag-label green" title="Lint is stable." aria-label="Lint is stable.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">verified_user</span>
                    <span>Stable</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="tag-label blue" title="Lint has one or more quick fixes available." aria-label="Lint has one or more quick fixes available.">
                    <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">build</span>
                    <span>Fix available</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>Avoid annotating types for function expression parameters.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> annotating types for function expression parameters.</p>
                <p>
                  Annotating types for function expression parameters is usually unnecessary
                  because the parameter types can almost always be inferred from the context,
                  thus making the practice redundant.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">var</span><span> </span><span>names</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span>people</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">.</span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">map</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Person</span><span> </span><span>person</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=&gt;</span><span> </span><span>person</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">.</span><span>name</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>GOOD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">var</span><span> </span><span>names</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=</span><span> </span><span>people</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">.</span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">map</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span>person</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">=&gt;</span><span> </span><span>person</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">.</span><span>name</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">;</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="incompatible-rules">Incompatible rules</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#incompatible-rules" aria-label="Link to 'Incompatible rules' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>The <code>avoid_types_on_closure_parameters</code> lint is incompatible with the following rules:</p>
                <ul><li><a href="/tools/linter-rules/always_specify_types"><code>always_specify_types</code></a></li></ul>
                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_types_on_closure_parameters</code> rule, add <code>avoid_types_on_closure_parameters</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_types_on_closure_parameters</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_types_on_closure_parameters: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>

    <script>
    const prefersDarkMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    
    const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light-mode';
    if (storedTheme === 'auto-mode') {
      document.body.classList.add(
          'auto-mode',
          prefersDarkMode.matches ? 'dark-mode' : 'light-mode',
      );
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add(storedTheme);
    }
    </script>

                  <h1 id="document-title">avoid_<wbr/>unnecessary_<wbr/>containers</h1>
                  <p class="page-description">Learn about the avoid_unnecessary_containers linter rule.</p>
                  <!--@page_header_options data={"title":"avoid_unnecessary_containers","sourceUrl":null,"issueUrl":"https://github.com/dart-lang/site-www/issues/new?template=1_page_issue.yml&amp;page-url=https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_unnecessary_containers"}-->

                <p>Avoid unnecessary containers.</p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="details">Details</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#details" aria-label="Link to 'Details' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p><strong>AVOID</strong> wrapping widgets in unnecessary containers.</p>
                <p>
                  Wrapping a widget in <code>Container</code> with no other parameters set has no effect
                  and makes code needlessly more complex.
                </p>
                <p><strong>BAD:</strong></p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-dart">
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language dart">dart</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Widget</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">buildRow</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">)</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">{</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">return</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Container</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>      </span><span>child</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Row</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">(</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>        </span><span>children</span><span style="color: rgba(189, 35, 20, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(255, 137, 126, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(20, 107, 205, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(107, 177, 255, 1.0);">Widget</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">[</span></span>

                <p><a id="usage" aria-hidden="true"></a></p>
                <div class="header-wrapper">
                  <h2 id="enable">Enable</h2>
                  <a class="heading-link" href="#enable" aria-label="Link to 'Enable' section">#</a>
                </div>
                <p>
                  To enable the <code>avoid_unnecessary_containers</code> rule, add <code>avoid_unnecessary_containers</code>
                   under
                  <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong> in your <a href="/tools/analysis"><code>analysis_options.yaml</code></a>
                   file:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span>-</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">avoid_unnecessary_containers</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
                    <!--@copy_button data={"buttonText":null,"toCopy":null,"classes":[],"title":"Copy code to clipboard"}-->
                    <button class="text-button icon-button copy-button hidden" title="Copy code to clipboard"><span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true" translate="no">content_copy</span></button>
                    <!--/@copy_button-->
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p>
                  If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules,
                  add <code>avoid_unnecessary_containers: true</code> under <strong>linter &gt; rules</strong>:
                </p>
                <div class="code-block-wrapper language-yaml">
                  <div class="code-block-header"><span>analysis_options.yaml</span></div>
                  <div class="code-block-body">
                    <span class="code-block-language" title="Language yaml">yaml</span>
                    <pre class="opal" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">linter</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>  </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span></span>
</span><span class="line"><span><span>    </span><span style="color: rgba(98, 0, 238, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(181, 129, 255, 1.0);">avoid_unnecessary_containers</span><span style="color: rgba(25, 28, 34, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(220, 220, 220, 1.0);">:</span><span> </span><span style="color: rgba(12, 112, 100, 1.0); --opal-dark-color: rgba(28, 218, 197, 1.0);">true</span></span>
</span></code></pre>
